Rajasthan Panchayat Elections: Voting Dates Announced for Sarpanch Polls

Voting dates for Sarpanch elections in Rajasthan have been announced. In Pholodi district, voting will take place on October 23 for some positions and on October 25 for Sarpanch. Election results for the district are scheduled for November 20.
